In today's dynamic and increasingly regulated banking environment, maintaining robust internal controls, risk management practices, and operational efficiency is critical for achieving both business objectives and regulatory compliance. The Internal Audit function plays a pivotal role in assessing the effectiveness of the Bank's internal processes, identifying areas for improvement, and providing assurance to the Board of Directors and senior management regarding the integrity and reliability of operations.

The Quality Assurance unit of Internal Audit Group has the mandate to ensure that the Bank’s risk management, governance, and control processes are adequate and effective. In 2025 and beyond, as part of our commitment to continuous improvement and in response to emerging risks, the End-to-End Process Reviews have been included in the Annual Internal Audit Plan. This addition is designed to provide a holistic view of key operational processes, assess the control environment across all stages of those processes, and identify gaps or inefficiencies that may expose the Bank to financial, regulatory, or operational risks.

The end-to-end process review involves comprehensive review of key processes from initiation to conclusion, including cross-functional and inter-departmental interactions. The review will concentrate on high-risk areas such as

By focusing on end-to-end processes review, our objective is to evaluate the interdependencies between departments, systems, and procedures, ensuring that risks are managed at every critical touchpoint. This approach aligns with the Bank’s strategic priorities and regulatory requirements while supporting ongoing efforts to improve operational effectiveness and customer service.
The proposed audit plan aims to enhance the Bank’s governance structure, foster a culture of continuous improvement
that the Bank is well-positioned to meet the challenges of a rapidly changing financial landscape while complying with existing regulatory frameworks.
